title: Strategic Capability Kernel over Existing Services
context: The platform already contains strong services and atomic capability operations, but abstraction levels are mixed and governance risks becoming role-driven.
decision: Introduce an authoritative strategic capability model and runtime above existing services. Keep atomic operations in registry/capabilities.json. Model reviews as stable capabilities and role assignments as configuration.
consequences: Existing services are reused without a big-bang rewrite
Capabilities become traceable from value chain to contracts, services, reviews and metrics
Organisational roles can change without changing platform architecture
Release validation can detect orphan dependencies, contracts, reviews and services
